mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as evidenced by a negative correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward positive return rate for S&P 500 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: High annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) predicts negative S&P 500 5-day returns, as measured by the inflation rate derived from the CPIAUCSL index.
failure_condition: Walk-forward negative return rate for S&P 500 5-day returns when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5% is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 470000) combined with robust housing starts (HOUST > 1150) predicts positive S&P 500 60-day returns, as these conditions signal a healthy economic expansion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward positive return rate for S&P 500 60-day returns when RSAFS > 470000 and HOUST > 1150 is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a strong labor force (PAYEMS > 146000) predicts positive S&P 500 20-day returns, indicating a positive labor market outlook.
failure_condition: Walk-forward positive return rate for S&P 500 20-day returns when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 146000 is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong consumer spending supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward positive return rate for S&P 500 20-day returns when RSAFS > 470000 is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) predicts negative S&P 500 20-day returns, as declining industrial output signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: Walk-forward negative return rate for S&P 500 20-day returns when INDPRO < 100 is below 50%.

failure_condition: Walk-forward negative return rate for S&P 500 20-day returns when CPIAUCSL > 245 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% is below 50%.
